theme: Light theme (Clinical / Laboratory setup), high contrast for readability and accuracy.
archetype: ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST (Authority, Clarity, Truth) adapted for Laboratory use. Very clean, sterile white and light grey backgrounds, with strong, unambiguous accent colors for data.

rules: NEVER use generic fonts (Inter/Roboto) for headings. Manrope gives it a technical yet approachable feel.
Headings must use tight letter spacing.
Data tables and specific sample IDs should use IBM Plex Sans or JetBrains Mono for readability of alphanumeric strings.

layouts.dashboard: High Density Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6). Left column for Upload/Analysis (col-span-8), Right column for ASTM Reference Chart (col-span-4).
layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-6 or p-8 inside cards. Use gap-6 or gap-8 between major sections.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #E2E8F0 on all cards to maintain crisp clinical separation.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Subtle ambient shadows (shadow-sm) on rest, shadow-md on hover. No harsh shadows.
visual_enhancers.radius: rounded-xl for main containers, rounded-md for inputs/buttons.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Avoid in data-heavy areas. Use only for sticky top navigation (bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl).

upload_zone.style: Dashed border (border-2 border-dashed border-slate-300), bg-slate-50, hover:bg-slate-100 transition-colors duration-200. Min-height 250px. Centered content.
upload_zone.icons: Use large Phosphor or Lucide icon (e.g., UploadCloud).

astm_reference_card.style: Sticky on desktop. Grid of 12 colors representing the ASTM D130 ratings. Each color block must show its rating (e.g., '1a') in contrasting text.

result_display.style: Large, bold typography for the rating (e.g., '2b'). Adjacent badge indicating the category. Notes input field below it.
result_display.buttons: Save to Database (Primary color), Export PDF (Secondary/Outline).

history_table.style: Shadcn Table. Clean, alternating row colors (bg-white / bg-slate-50). Status badges for the ratings.

motion.hover: Subtle lift (-translate-y-0.5) and shadow increase on cards.
motion.transitions: transition-all duration-200 ease-out on buttons and interactive elements. Avoid universal 'transition: all' that breaks transforms.
motion.upload: Highlight border and scale up icon slightly on dragOver.

empty_state_upload.description: Copper metal texture - useful for an empty state background inside the upload box or a small decorative thumbnail.

hero_laboratory.description: Lab testing analysis - can be used as a subtle header background or for the app's initial welcome screen/login if needed.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over color badges meets 4.5:1 ratio. The ASTM colors must have dark text if the color is light, and white text if the color is dark.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements, buttons, table rows, and form inputs MUST have descriptive 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., data-testid='upload-dropzone', data-testid='save-analysis-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent: Design a web application tailored for laboratory technicians to analyze Copper Strip Corrosion according to ASTM D130.
Use standard HTML/Tailwind for structural layout and Shadcn UI components for complex interactions (Tables, Dropdowns, Modals, Inputs).
The application should have two main views: 1) The Analyzer (Upload, Result, Save) and 2) History (Table of past results, Export CSV/PDF).
MOCK AI FUNCTIONALITY: Simulate the AI vision by automatically showing a mock result (e.g., Rating '2b', Category 'Moderate Tarnish') 2 seconds after an image is uploaded.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds in headers or dropdowns.
Recreate the ASTM D130 color chart in the UI using CSS background colors provided in 'astm_d130_reference'. This chart should be permanently visible as a reference guide.
Maintain a highly clinical, crisp, and high-contrast 'Swiss' design language. The data and results should be the focal point.
Ensure 'data-testid' is comprehensively applied across all logical interactions.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use lucide-react.
DO NOT write .tsx files, use .js or .jsx if required, but primarily focus on standard Javascript React patterns based on project setup.
